Our suite of tools—including CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Jinny—streamlines every stage of the garment creation process, while platforms like CLO-SET and CONNECT enable seamless collaboration, content management, and digital asset workflows. Through smart tagging technology, CLO also links physical and digital garments, creating an integrated and intelligent fashion infrastructure built for the future of design and sustainability. CLO Virtual Fashion, a global leader in digital fashion innovation, operates across 16 offices in 13 countries—including key hubs in Asia, North America, Europe, and South America. As the demand for immersive, tech-driven fashion solutions grows, CLO continues to expand its global footprint, powered by a rapidly growing international user base and a future-focused vision. jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description_text: CLO Virtual Fashion is the creator of CLO and Marvelous Designer, the top 3D garment design programs used in fashion, film, and game development. With over two decades of research and development in accurate garment simulation, CLO Virtual Fashion's mission is to empower users at every step of the garment journey, from concept to design, manufacturing to marketing, and fitting to styling. In addition to 3D garment design software, CLO Virtual Fashion's products include CLO-SET (a digital asset management and collaboration platform), CONNECT (a digital fashion hub and marketplace), and consumer-facing solutions such as e-commerce virtual fittings. Founded in 2009, CLO's interconnected and ever-growing product ecosystem is built to power the future of everything related to garments. CLO Virtual Fashion currently has 14 offices located in 12 countries across North America, Asia, Europe, and South America, and continues to expand to serve users around the globe. Position Overview We are seeking an Employee Experience Manager to join our fast-moving CLO Virtual Fashion team. While aligning with the Global People & Culture Team, you will be the Culture Evangelist who helps employees align with the company’s mission & vision. Simultaneously, while maintaining seamless communication with the many stakeholders, you need to engage to increase operational efficiencies and create an environment where employees can focus on their own roles and responsibilities.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Eko Health builds devices and software that help clinicians detect heart and lung disease earlier. We’re looking for a Manager, Cost Accounting & Procure-to-Pay, remote in the US on Pacific hours, to own two things at the center of our business: what it costs us to put a device in a clinician’s hands, and how we pay for everything that gets it there.This is a build role. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, you will set Eko’s costing methodology and defend it to our auditors, own inventory valuation and reserves, run landed cost end to end, close COGS each month, and run procure-to-pay from purchase order to payment. You will partner with Supply Chain, Sales Operations, and FP&A, and your margin analysis will reach the executive team. You inherit a working foundation and a lot of room to make it better.A few things make this role unusual. Eko does not run a factory: devices are built by contract manufacturers and bought as finished goods, so cost is purchase price plus landed cost, and inventory sits with partners we cannot walk into. Hardware is sold alongside subscription software, so the margin story is blended. And this is a hands-on manager role with no direct reports to start: you provide review oversight to our offshore transactional team while personally owning the higher-judgment accounting, reconciliations, close, and conclusions. If you like building both the methodology and the reconciliation behind it, you will thrive here. Essential Functions Cost

jobs.description_text: Job Summary: The Enlistment Waiver Specialist supports the Ohio Army National Guard Recruiting and Retention Battalion (RRB) at Beightler Armory by reviewing, preparing, and tracking enlistment waivers (medical, moral, administrative, and prior service) and Military Entrance Processing Station (MEPS) physical requests using national systems. Recruiters and NCOICs will rely on you for clear, well-supported answers on what the regulations allow, often on short timelines. jobs.title: Training Solution Consultant SME
jobs.description_text: Position Overview The Training Solution Consultant will serve as an embedded training and user-support resource for an assigned Tier 1 Subject Matter Expert (SME) team. The consultant will help ensure end users receive timely, site-specific support; identify and coordinate refresher-training needs; provide input on training-content updates; and strengthen adoption of processes, systems, and tools supported by the Tier. This is a contractor / 1099 role supporting Tier 1 and Solution Teams / Some travel may be required for on-site working sessions. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Maga
